clauses.scope_note: Section 11.3: OpenAI-granted Customer rights cease immediately upon termination. OriginalArtifact represents the Services; this clause captures the resulting end of the Customer’s right to use them.
clauses.condition_explanation: agreement_terminated means the Agreement has terminated. The Agreement’s term and termination triggers are described in Sections 11.1–11.2.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the Services under rights granted by OpenAI after the Agreement terminates.
obligation_items.trigger: Immediately upon termination; this restriction concerns rights granted by OpenAI under the Agreement.

coverage_notes: Section 11.3 also requires OpenAI to delete Customer Content within 30 days after termination, subject to legal-retention and written-agreement exceptions, and provides separate permissions to retain or share Abusive Customer Content in specified circumstances. Those deletion and retention duties/permissions are not faithfully expressible with the available activities.

Sections 11.2, 11.3, 13.3, and 13.4 contain termination rights, accrued-payment and minimum-commitment consequences, indemnity duties, mitigation steps, compliance-with-instructions duties, and claim-handling duties that do not map faithfully to the available activities; these paragraphs are marked UNRESOLVED.

Sections 12.1–12.2 and 12.3(b)–(e) are warranties, disclaimers, or descriptions of Beta Services and their risks, not activity constraints for this extraction. Section 12.3(a) gives Customer a choice to use Beta Services, but the supplied activities do not represent that choice distinctly from general service use.

Section 14 sets liability limitations and exceptions, not activity constraints. External Service-Specific Terms Indemnity is incorporated by reference but not supplied; its content cannot be inferred.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 11.3’s cessation of Customer’s service-use rights is modeled. The same target paragraph also includes OpenAI’s conditional Customer Content deletion and retention/sharing provisions, plus accrued-payment and minimum-commitment consequences; these are not fully represented by the available activities.

The target paragraph contains a warranty, warranty disclaimers, descriptions of Beta Services, and a statement that Customer may choose to use them. It creates no operative activity constraint representable here; the choice to use Beta Services is not a distinct available activity.

The target paragraph imposes indemnity duties on both parties, requires Customer to follow reasonable mitigation instructions, and sets claim-notice, cooperation, defense-control, and settlement duties. These duties do not map faithfully to the available activities.
The target paragraph limits liability and specifies exceptions; it does not grant, prohibit, or require an activity.
